mandir.hero.title: Mandir Manners
mandir.hero.subtitle: Guidelines for a Respectful Temple Visit
mandir.section.title: Temple Etiquette & Guidelines
mandir.before.title: 🙏 Before Entering
mandir.before.item1: Remove your shoes before entering the temple premises
mandir.before.item2: Dress modestly - avoid shorts, sleeveless tops, and revealing clothing
mandir.before.item3: Switch off or silence your mobile phone
mandir.before.item4: Wash your hands and feet if facilities are available
mandir.inside.title: 🕉️ Inside the Temple
mandir.inside.item1: Maintain silence and speak softly if necessary
mandir.inside.item2: Do not touch the deities or sacred objects without permission
mandir.inside.item3: Photography may be restricted - please ask before taking photos
mandir.inside.item4: Do not sit with your feet pointing towards the deity
mandir.inside.item5: Participate respectfully in prayers and rituals
mandir.inside.item6: Do not eat, drink, or chew inside the temple
mandir.families.title: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 For Families
mandir.families.item1: Keep children close and ensure they remain respectful
mandir.families.item2: Avoid bringing food or toys that may cause distraction
mandir.families.item3: Use the designated areas for children if available
mandir.donations.title: 💰 Donations & Offerings
mandir.donations.item1: Donations are welcome but never mandatory
mandir.donations.item3: Prasad (blessed food) should be accepted with respect
mandir.donations.item4: Do not leave offerings in unauthorized places
mandir.courtesy.title: ❤️ General Courtesy
mandir.courtesy.item1: Respect other devotees' space and devotion
mandir.courtesy.item2: Avoid pushing or rushing during crowded times
mandir.courtesy.item3: Follow instructions from temple staff and volunteers
mandir.courtesy.item4: Keep the premises clean - use trash bins
mandir.courtesy.item5: Be patient during queues for darshan
mandir.note.label: Remember:
mandir.note.text: The temple is a sacred space for spiritual connection. Your respectful behavior helps maintain the sanctity and peace of this holy place for all devotees.
